sources.title: Burkina Faso
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live but undated SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly addresses Mexican tourists, assigns their Burkina Faso visa applications to the French Embassy in Mexico, and separately excludes arrival processing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La Embajada de Francia en México atiende las solicitudes de visas para mexicanos.

sources.title: Visa
sources.publisher: Embassy of Burkina Faso in Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: The live diplomatie.gov.bf page identifies the Embassy of Burkina Faso in Türkiye and directs short-stay entry-visa applicants to the national Visa Burkina platform for online processing and emailed eVisa delivery.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les demandes de visa d’entrée au Burkina Faso se font depuis le 1er février 2023 en ligne.

sources.title: Central African Republic
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly says Mexican travelers need a Central African visa and identifies the French Consulate in Mexico as the processing mission.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas mexicanas SI necesitan visa para viajar a República Centroafricana, se tramita en el Consulado francés en la Ciudad de México.

sources.title: Republic of the Congo
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly says Mexican travelers need a visa and identifies the Republic of the Congo embassy in the United States as the processing mission.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas mexicanas SI necesitan visa para viajar a Congo, la cual se tramita en la Embajada de la República del Congo en Estados Unidos.

sources.title: Guinea-Bissau
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly requires Mexican travelers to hold a visa and identifies diplomatic representations as the non-invitation route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Se obtiene en las representaciones diplomáticas de Guinea Bissau en los siguientes países: Dakar, Senegal; Lisboa, Portugal o París, Francia.

sources.title: Liberia
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live but undated SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly says Mexican tourists need a visa and that the Liberian Embassy in Washington accepts their visa requests by post.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La Embajada de Liberia en Washington D.C., Estados Unidos, atiende por correo postal las solicitudes de visas para mexicanos.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live lis.gov.lr Visa on Arrival service identifies the Liberia Immigration Service as the authority responsible for the Alien and Nationality Law and sets an applicant-country embassy condition for use of the portal.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Niger
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly says Mexican travelers need a visa and identifies the Embassy of Niger in the United States as the processing mission.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas mexicanas SI necesitan visa para viajar a Níger, se tramita en la Embajada de Níger en Estados Unidos.

sources.title: Palestine
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly describes the nominal Palestinian tourist-visa treatment for Mexican travelers, but not a controlled entry-crossing procedure.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas mexicanas NO necesitan visa para viajar a Palestina como turistas.

sources.title: São Tomé and Príncipe
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly says Mexican travelers need a visa and identifies the nearest São Tomé and Príncipe mission in New York.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas mexicanas SI necesitan visa para viajar a Santo Tomé y Príncipe, la misión más cercana es en Nueva York.

sources.title: Sierra Leone
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Live but undated SRE traveler guidance on Mexico's official government portal directly routes Mexican visa applications to Sierra Leone's mission in Washington and separately excludes arrival processing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Los mexicanos deberán solicitar la visa de Sierra Leona en Washington.

sources.title: Government of Sierra Leone eVisa system: live eligibility terms
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The live evisa.sl service is linked as the official portal by the Sierra Leone Immigration Department. Its current terms make all non-ECOWAS countries eligible to apply, which includes Mexico, but do not resolve the conflicting issuance point.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Countries with exception of all members of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)

sources.title: Government of Sierra Leone eVisa system: live electronic-delivery terms
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The SLID-authenticated live eVisa service says an accepted eVisa is emailed, but this directly conflicts with its airport-or-border issuance FAQ.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If your eVisa application is accepted, we will be sending you the eVisa as an email attachment.

sources.title: Government of Sierra Leone eVisa system: live airport-or-border issuance FAQ
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The same SLID-authenticated live eVisa service says the visa is issued on arrival at an airport or border after approval, directly contradicting its emailed-eVisa terms.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa application has been approved, you'll be issued your Visa upon arrival at the airport or border.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Central African Republic advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mexico's live traveler guidance directs Mexican travelers to the French Consulate in Mexico for the Central African Republic visa.
conditions: Limited to ordinary Mexican-passport short visitor travel; work, residence and special passport routes are outside this policy.
The cited guidance identifies the French Consulate in Mexico as the processing mission.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mexico's live traveler guidance directs Mexican travelers to the Republic of the Congo embassy in the United States for visa processing.
conditions: Limited to ordinary Mexican-passport short visitor travel; work, residence and special passport routes are outside this policy.
The cited guidance identifies the Republic of the Congo embassy in the United States as the processing mission.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Guinea-Bissau advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mexico's live traveler guidance says Mexican travelers obtain the visa through Guinea-Bissau diplomatic representations; its separate invitation-based arrival possibility is not normalized here.
conditions: Limited to ordinary Mexican-passport short visitor travel through the stated diplomatic representations; work, residence and special passport routes are outside this policy.
The source's invitation-dependent possibility of requesting a visa on arrival is excluded from this unconditional policy.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Niger advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mexico's live traveler guidance directs Mexican travelers to the Embassy of Niger in the United States for visa processing.
conditions: Limited to ordinary Mexican-passport short visitor travel; work, residence and special passport routes are outside this policy.
The cited guidance identifies the Embassy of Niger in the United States as the processing mission.

conflicts.explanation: The live but undated SRE mission wording is superseded in issuance mode by Burkina Faso's current official online eVisa process. That newer process does not directly map Mexican passports or establish that Mexico is visa-subject, so the fallback eVisa status is not established.

The current official Mexican guide provides diplomatic-representation processing as the ordinary route. Its separate arrival possibility depends on an invitation, so it does not support a nationality-wide visa-on-arrival status.

The live but undated SRE postal-mission wording does not reconcile with Liberia Immigration's current Visa on Arrival service, which makes portal use dependent on whether the applicant has a Liberian embassy in their country. No current source maps an ordinary Mexican passport to one unconditional issuance route, so the fallback eVisa status is not established.

The current SRE guide calls Mexican tourists visa-free for Palestine, but it does not establish a Palestinian-controlled entry crossing or whether Israeli ETA-IL and crossing controls apply. The standalone ETA status is therefore not established.

Mexico's live official traveler guidance says Mexican travelers need a São Tomé and Príncipe visa and identifies the nearest mission, but does not say an application is filed there or establish electronic, mission or border issuance timing.

The live but undated SRE Washington-mission route is contradicted by Sierra Leone's current official service, which makes Mexico eligible as a non-ECOWAS country but conflicts between emailed eVisa delivery and airport-or-border visa issuance. The fallback advance-visa status is not established.

unresolved.reason: Mexico's current guide says to request a visa at a nearby Afghan embassy or consulate, but no current official source establishes a functioning ordinary Mexican-passport short-visitor issuance channel; a normalized status is not established.
No current BVI authority source directly establishes ordinary Mexican-passport short-visitor treatment. The BVI visa-national PDF does not name Mexico, and its omission cannot establish a status.

The live but undated SRE page gives a French-mission route, while Burkina Faso's current official process requires online short-stay visa applications and emails an EVISA after approval. The current destination source does not directly map Mexican passports or establish that Mexico is visa-subject, so no issuance status is normalized and the fallback eVisa status is not established.

Mexico's live guide says Mexican tourists need an Ivorian visa, but no current official source directly establishes ordinary Mexican-passport eligibility together with actual electronic, mission or border issuance timing; the fallback eVisa status is not established.

Mexico's live guide requires a visa valid at arrival and links Djibouti's official eVisa service, but it does not establish ordinary Mexican-passport eligibility or actual issuance timing. The fallback arrival status is not established.

The current SRE Iraq page contains no operative visa rule, and no current federal Iraqi authority source established the ordinary Mexican-passport short-visitor route and issuance timing. Kurdistan Region procedures are not transferred to federal Iraq; a status is not established.

Mexico's current guide requires a prior Kuwaiti visa and says Kuwaiti embassies are not currently issuing visas. That operational unavailability does not establish a normal ordinary Mexican-passport visitor route.

The live but undated SRE page gives a postal Washington-mission route, but Liberia Immigration's current Visa on Arrival service makes use of the portal conditional on whether the applicant has a Liberian embassy in their country. No current authority maps an ordinary Mexican passport to an unconditional mission, electronic or airport route, so the fallback eVisa status is not established.
Mexico's live guide says Mexican tourists need a Malian visa but only refers readers to a mission for requirements; actual ordinary Mexican-passport mission issuance timing is not established.

The live SRE DPRK page contains unrelated United States content and does not establish a normal ordinary Mexican-passport visitor route. Operational restrictions cannot be represented as an ordinary advance-visa status.

Current SRE guidance calls Mexican tourists visa-free, but it does not establish the actual crossing authority, Israeli ETA-IL treatment or security-control conditions. A normalized Palestinian Territory status is not established.

Mexico's live guide says Mexican travelers need a São Tomé and Príncipe visa and identifies the nearest mission in New York, but it does not state that applications are filed there or establish actual electronic, mission or border issuance timing. The fallback eVisa status is not established.

The live but undated SRE page's Washington-mission route conflicts with Sierra Leone Immigration's current authenticated eVisa service. Mexico is in its all-non-ECOWAS eligibility cohort, but the service says both that an eVisa is emailed after acceptance and that the visa is issued at the airport or border. The ordinary Mexican-passport issuance status, including the fallback advance-visa label, is not established.

Mexico's live guide says Mexican visitors need a valid Solomon Islands visa, but no current direct official source establishes whether it is issued before travel, electronically or at the border. A normalized issuance status is not established.

Mexico's live guide says Mexican travelers need a visa and links the South Sudan eVisa site, but does not directly establish Mexican eligibility or actual electronic issuance. Its surrounding entry text is internally inconsistent, so a normalized status is not established.

Mexico's live Syria guide lists tourist documentation but does not establish whether or when an ordinary Mexican passport receives a visitor visa or authorization. The operational visitor route is not established.

Mexico's live guide says Mexican travelers need a Turkmen visa and a certified invitation letter. This invitation-dependent route does not establish an unconditional ordinary Mexican-passport short-visitor baseline.
